design: Q&A-only Haiku 5.5 scoring of the 21-call Equibles pilot (PEAD 20-day horizon; bleak tone change = QoQ score delta; evasion + analyst tone per call). No return test in this pilot.
assumptions: Pilot size is 21 calls, not 19: the coverage doc and the task brief say 19, but the defined set (ABT/AMGN/AMZN x4 + ABBV/AMD/AMT x3) is 4+4+4+3+3+3 = 21, and cells.json lists 21 cells. All 21 were scored.

Q&A span = first Analyst turn, stepped back over the immediately preceding Operator/IR turn when it announces questions; ends before the closing 'concludes' turn. Prepared remarks excluded. (The naive 'first turn containing question and answer session' rule misfires: AMT FY2026 Q3's closing turn reads 'This concludes our question and answer session'.)
Bleak tone change is the deterministic QoQ change in the Q&A score within a ticker, not a model judgement.
Scores are a pilot diagnostic only: 21 calls, no post-call returns computed here, no IC, no trading signal.
